title.de: Adapter SDK mit Capability-Manifest und Contract-Tests
title.en: Adapter SDK with capability manifest and contract tests

summary.de: packages/adapter-sdk exportiert Manifest-Schema, Capability-Enum und Contract-Harness. Kern lädt Adapter über Manifest + Allowlist + Version Lock (FR-024, CON-005).
summary.en: packages/adapter-sdk exports manifest schema, capability enum, and contract harness. Core loads adapters via manifest + allowlist + version lock (FR-024, CON-005).

plain_language.de: Adapter sind keine Forks. Manifest + Contract-Harness halten die Grenze sauber.
plain_language.en: Adapters are not forks. Manifest + contract harness keep the boundary clean.

why_it_matters.de: Ohne Adapter SDK können Godot/Tauri nicht sauber angebunden werden (FR-024).
why_it_matters.en: Without the adapter SDK, Godot/Tauri cannot be plugged in cleanly (FR-024).

de: Manifest erfordert id, version, capabilities, detectors.
en: Manifest requires id, version, capabilities, detectors.
Adapters implement contract, not core internals.
Fake adapter tests document the boundary.
